objective: Qualify seven synchronous installed smoke callers and their transitive helpers without ambient Git effects or lost failure diagnostics.
implementation: Seven callers now use runInstalledSmoke, owned Node/npm/Git dispatch, private npm configuration, deferred installation after artifact admission, and verified cleanup before success.
Three transitive helpers require explicit caller controllers; Node preloads reach deliberate refusal traps through nodeArgs.
Shared finalization preserves nested aggregate/cause diagnostics while retaining error identities and independent cleanup.
Imported init exercises accept an explicit controller through a factory or named export; missing controllers refuse before writes.
Command-matrix synthetic contract nodes are fully wired before the next allocation; no-reindex does not waive authored-source validity.
Synthetic modified bundle policy hash is rebound after payload rehash; all bundle verification and projection-neutrality assertions remain.
